BSofDeath/radio.bsod.kr.description: A webpage that compiles internet stream URLs for all radio stations in South Korea (runs on a serverless app built on Cloudflare Workers)
BSofDeath/radio.bsod.kr.body:
# radio.bsod.kr
This project collects and compiles the stream URLs of all radio stations in South Korea to build a **radio player** web app that lets you listen to the broadcast you want in real time with a single click on the web.

To help people planning derivative projects, the README outlines part of the **actual production operating structure** and the **stream URL acquisition methods for major stations** gathered during development.

> Written as of November 2026. Applicability may differ from reality due to changes in station policies and other factors.

## Production operating structure
* This repository stores the static files that make up the web app. In the [production](https://radio.bsod.kr) environment, these are deployed and hosted on **Cloudflare Pages**.
* The [template](https://github.com/BSofDeath/radio.bsod.kr/blob/HEAD/functions/api/template) of predefined URLs and the logic for fetching stream URLs from station servers are handled by Cloudflare's serverless functions (**Pages Functions**). The web app uses the URLs obtained this way to play broadcasts (using libraries such as hls.js where necessary).

## How stream URLs are obtained
* Most stations serve HLS (m3u8) streams at fixed stream URLs. These URLs are predefined in the [template](https://github.com/BSofDeath/radio.bsod.kr/blob/HEAD/functions/api/template).
* However, some stations use their own APIs to issue tokens with an expiration period for access control, and include them as part of the stream URL. Because of this, **part of the URL changes each time you connect, and a URL once obtained becomes unusable after a certain time**, so these stations require additional measures when obtaining URLs.
  * In the [production](https://radio.bsod.kr) environment, which runs on Cloudflare services, **Pages Functions** temporarily store the URLs received from the station APIs in **Workers KV** storage for up to 12 hours and reuse them,…

LarryE135/dsh-flash-presets.description: Reducing Token consumption for DeepSeek v4.1flash / Raising Token efficiency without losing performance (Works for v4.1flash)
LarryE135/dsh-flash-presets.body:
# dsh-flash-presets

Agent presets for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH), tuned for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash.

Core elements: a shorter context window, tool trimming, optimization of low-frequency tools, and merged `run_code` calls. This plugin cannot raise the model's capability ceiling, but it can complete tasks within the model's capability range at a lower budget.

The whole package is delivered as a DSH bundle (`dsh.bundle`): it inserts preset rows into the profile and does not modify host source code. **Three items take effect for the entire profile at runtime:** the resident PTC runtime (the `ptc-runtime` override in the patch, which applies to **all** presets of that profile; to turn it off, the plugin card must be removed), the read-only concurrency flag for `glob` / `grep` (`DSH_FLASH_PRESETS_CONCURRENCY=0` disables it), and the resolution of old preset ids (`DSH_FLASH_PRESETS_ALIAS=0` disables it).

> Current version: v0.3.0 (2026-11-07) · presets v3 / v3 balance · plan mode plan-mode v1 (1.0.0) · requires DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.2.3-0` (`engines` gate: installation is refused, and on startup a DSH version outside the range skips this plugin; you can allow it at your own risk with `dsh plugin allow-version`; script installation does not go through this gate). Tested with 0.2.1-rc.5 and 0.2.2-rc.1.
>
> To install from npm, pin the version: `dsh-flash-presets@0.3.0` (`npm view dsh-flash-presets version` can verify). Fixes to CI and the bundled docs have been landing on `main` gradually, **but there has been no version bump and no Release** — the published release is still the same 0.3.0. **Do not install 0.2.5** — on DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 it cannot create new sessions (#19).

## Who it suits and who it doesn't

**Suits**

- Tasks with clear goals and acceptance criteria: changing code, running scripts, organizing data, producing deliverables in a given format.
- Long sessions. The default compaction threshold is 80% of context, which most sessions never reach; this preset changes it to 25%, so context in long sessions stays under control.
- People who care about their token bill and don't want to repeat instructions to the model in every message.

**Doesn't suit**

- Problems clearly beyond the model's capability, such as competition-level problems aimed at earning partial credit. For these tasks standard mode is more stable; the data is in the [empirical evidence](https://github.com/LarryE135/dsh-flash-presets/blob/HEAD/docs/实测证据.md).

## iOS App Maintenance

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 16.19.1
MOBILE=1 npm run docs:build

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2
npx cap sync ios
npx cap open ios
```

Starfie1d1272/Mizar.description: An open-source production and broadcast system for campus and community CS2 tournaments, integrating automated program sequencing, a production workstation, HUD, radar, and tournament materials.
Starfie1d1272/Mizar.body:
**[Download Windows installer (GitHub)](https://github.com/Starfie1d1272/Mizar/releases/latest)** · [Full GitHub download and release notes](https://github.com/Starfie1d1272/Mizar/releases)

For first use, choose the Windows x64 lightweight installer whose name ends with `-WebInstaller.exe` and follow the wizard to complete the installation. The portable ZIP is for users who want to extract it, run it, and manage the program directory themselves. Historical versions and checksum files are on GitHub Releases. For installation and upgrade steps, see [Quick Start](https://github.com/Starfie1d1272/Mizar/blob/HEAD/docs/guide/quick-start.md).

Mizar is an open-source production system built for campus and community CS2 tournaments. From pre-match introductions to post-match freeze frames, it gives a match a coherent program flow, a unified visual package, and on-site tools that commentators and directors can use at hand.

_Match footage, the large radar, and production controls, all in view. [See more footage](https://github.com/Starfie1d1272/Mizar/blob/HEAD/docs/screenshots/README.md)._

## The program shows wherever the match is

Pre-match waiting, BP display, match opening, in-game HUD, halftime stats, and post-match results. Mizar reads game progress through GSI and, combined with tournament data, automatically advances the program and switches OBS scenes. Fewer repetitive steps, more attention left for the match.

When live adjustments are needed, you can take manual control at any time, and you decide when to return to automatic.

_Ban, pick, and decider maps are presented in sequence so viewers can follow both teams' map arrangements. [View static frame](https://github.com/Starfie1d1272/Mizar/blob/HEAD/docs/screenshots/program-veto.png)._

## See the match, and also control the broadcast

In the Windows production workstation, view live CS2 footage, the large radar, and match data at the same time. Commentators can more easily grasp the overall picture, and directors can confirm on-site conditions through periodic OBS picture previews, stream status, and Bilibili live-status.

## From the first frame to the final score, one consistent style

The default **Mizar Pulse** package runs through pre-match, in-game, and post-match. Four other HUD styles are also available, referencing the visual identities of EWC, IEM, Perfect World, and ESL tournaments.

Adjust components, layout, and appearance, and preview until you are satisfied before using them on air. You can also share presets so the next event can keep a familiar style.

cyj265/lanxing-vod.description: 揽星影视 · Android phone video on-demand / live streaming player (compatible with TVBox JSON interface), supporting DLNA casting, live EPG and time-shift, multi-repository source management, and a frosted-glass UI. Secondary development based on Fongmi TV.
cyj265/lanxing-vod.body:
# 揽星影视

An audio-video app for Android phones (including tablets / foldables), developed as a secondary build based on [FongMi/TV](https://github.com/FongMi/TV). It integrates media browsing and playback, is compatible with the TVBox (JSON) interface protocol, and supports external configuration and [CatVod](https://github.com/CatVodTVOfficial/CatVodTVJarLoader) Spider interface extensions.

**The App itself does not bundle or provide any content sources.** External content must be configured by the user. You can also open local media files or push media URLs.

## Project Overview

揽星影视 builds on the upstream FongMi/TV core with a phone-oriented experience overhaul. Main differences:

- **Frosted-glass UI**: the playback page, settings page, dialogs, and more widely use a frosted-glass (Blur) style.
- **Customizable bottom navigation tabs**: the home page bottom navigation can be reordered and shown or hidden.
- **Picture-in-picture (PiP)**: phone playback supports picture-in-picture.
- **Enhanced live streaming**: live EPG program guide, Catchup replay, and time-shift.
- **Casting**: the DLNA sender (phone) uses a self-developed lightweight SSDP discovery and SOAP control stack; the receiver side uses jupnp.
- **Multi-repository / multi-source aggregation**: repository management supports two modes, multi-source aggregation and line collections, with one-click switch, refresh, copy, and delete.
- **Home recommendation slots**: connects to home data such as Douban charts, site recommendations, and TV charts.
- **Sound effect modes**: multiple EQ presets including Cinema / Heavy Bass / 3D Surround / HiFi / Vocal.
- **Bugly reporting** and online update checks based on GitHub Releases (the version number is used to determine new versions; the logic is consistent with 揽星TV).

> The playback core **uses only ExoPlayer (Media3)**; the original MPV branch has been removed.

## Getting Started

1. Install the APK suited to your device: only the phone build `mobile` is published, 64-bit `arm64-v8a`. The minimum requirement is Android 7.0 (API 24). The TV build (`leanback`) is no longer maintained or distributed. Users with the TV build installed can simply overwrite-install the phone build, and data and configuration are preserved. The old 5.4.x release line is likewise no longer maintained. 5.4 users can overwrite-install the current version directly; signatures match, and data and configuration are preserved.
2. Add your own configuration in Settings (compatible with the TVBox JSON interface). For format and fields, see the [configuration example](https://fongmi.github.io/TV/config/#examples).
3. You can also open local media files from the system file manager, or play media URLs via the push entry point.

## Main Features

- **Playback**: Media3 / ExoPlayer; subtitles, danmaku, audio tracks, playback speed, skip intro / outro, on-screen display (resolution / network speed / battery).
- **Browsing and management**: category filtering, search, playback history, favorites, and incognito mode.
-…

ml8s/liki.description: Liki — Professional Chinese metaphysics Skill: astronomical-engine charting, judgments with classical citations, verifiable conclusions. BaZi · ZiWei · Liuyao · QiMen · Date Selection · Feng Shui · Naming.
ml8s/liki.body:
Understand metaphysics? Use Liki.
Reproducible charting · Traceable judgments · Limits stated openly
BaZi · ZiWei · Liuyao · QiMen · Date Selection · Feng Shui · Naming ## Why Liki Asking a large language model to cast a chart directly can yield three different answers when the same chart is asked three times. Metaphysics is exactly where “a hair's breadth off, a thousand miles astray” applies: if a solar-term boundary is off by one day, the year pillar changes, and every judgment that follows is wrong too. So Liki turns each error-prone step into an explicit process: charts are cross-checked across multiple sources, judgments come from a rule truth table, and times are normalized before they are examined. **Conclusions are computed, not improvised on the spot by a model.** - ✅ **Reproducible charting** — the same input always yields the same chart; solar terms and true solar time are handled by the astronomical calendar engine - ✅ **Traceable judgments** — every conclusion carries its factor basis and can be traced back to the original text in 《三命通会》 (*Sanming Tonghui*) and 《滴天髓》 (*Ditian Sui*) - ✅ **Limits stated openly** — calibrate when the birth hour is sensitive, say so when evidence is insufficient, never default, never fabricate ## Three Focus Areas Below are three areas that are most easily overlooked and that best distinguish Liki. ### Focus 1 | Charting engine: cross-checked against three open-source implementations The charting engine was not written in one pass. `192` solar-term boundary cases (2024–2027, 24 solar terms per year × 2 anchor points per term) were cross-checked against three open-source implementations, **lunar-python, sxtwl, and bazi-calculator**, under a single rule: `all_oracles_must_agree` — any disagreement blocks a pass. The ZiWei implementation is aligned with an iztro-compatible data source. Where the engine disagreed with the classics, it was corrected against the original text and fixed as regression-prevention anchors: > Correction example from 《穷通宝鉴》 (*Qiongtong Baojian*): **Yi wood (乙木) grows toward the sun and relies exclusively on Bing fire (丙火); when water is excessive, Wu earth (戊) is used as support.** > The engine's output aligns word for word with this passage, and it is also fully compared against a reference table of 120 original-text entries. ### Focus 2 | Direct judgments: 829 real exam questions + a truth table fitted to the classics Judgments are not generated by a model; they are “matched” from a truth table: **829 judgments, 893 condition groups, 1355 condition rows**, built on 511 natal factors and 111 annual (liunian) factors. A match yields a direct judgment; no match is stated openly — there is no room for improvised phrasing. Every judgment carries its own basis and classical source, for example this real entry: | Judgment | Basis | | --- | --- | | Wood absent from the Five Elements: liver/gallbladder/sinews/eyes tend to be weak | Wood governs the liver (*Huangdi Neijing*: “The East generates wind, wind generates wood, wood generates sour, sour generates the liver”) | Two design details: - Annual (liunian) judgments must carry the **triggering factor of that year**; otherwise data validation fails outright. An open-source, five-language, multi-project monitoring dashboard centered on **IOTA Train at Home**. It supports IOTA, XID / MMM, Quantus, fly.ai, Nosana, Gonka, Akash, io.net, Vast.ai and Golem; each project's inputs, cycles, and data coverage are described separately.

IOTA Train at Home (Macrocosmos / Bittensor SN9) is the core project, with ten project pages covering training, mining and compute. Tool pages query records; separate tutorials explain identifiers, fields and troubleshooting. Public projects use public identifiers; io.net and Vast.ai require account connections with read credentials. Those two integrations have mocked validation; real-account validation remains pending.

The screenshot shows miner distribution and network capacity; the figures are official data as of when the screenshot was taken.

## Features

- **Multi-device monitoring**: add, name, and view devices by public Miner ID, filtering by contributing, waiting for tasks, needs checking, and pending confirmation.

Claude Code / Claude Agent SDK / Codex / Grok Build 4 runtimes + 8+ LLM providers (Anthropic / OpenAI / xAI / MiniMax / DeepSeek / GLM / Kimi / 书生 / 小米 MiMo), with a built-in Web Dashboard. sleep2agi/agent-network.body:
**[🌐 Website](https://anet.sh) · [⬇️ Download desktop app](https://www.anet.sh/download) · [🚀 Quick start](https://anet.sh/guide/getting-started) · [▶️ 48-second intro video](https://anet.sh) · Chinese · [English](https://github.com/sleep2agi/agent-network/blob/HEAD/README.en.md)**

**An enterprise-grade open-source version of Grok Bot, better suited for private on-premises deployment inside companies.**

Connect Claude Code, Codex, Grok, and OpenCode running on multiple machines into one agent legion, and command them all from a single desktop app.

## Why Agent Network

- 🤖 **A cross-machine agent legion**: Claude Code, Claude Agent SDK, Codex, Grok Build, and OpenCode can all join the same network as nodes. Nodes discover each other and dispatch work to one another through MCP.
- 🛰️ **One Hub connecting all machines**: CommHub exposes tools through MCP and delivers tasks in real time through SSE. Each machine runs one `anet daemon`, so you can create, start, and stop nodes on that machine remotely from the client.
- 💬 **One client to manage everything**: Desktop (macOS / Windows) and Android. Dispatch work through chat and send or receive files. The Tasks page manages projects, subtasks, GitHub Issues, and timestamps down to the second. The UI can switch between Chinese and English. You can view node and Hub logs. Rule files, skills, project directories, remote model switching, and restart are all still available. iOS is distributed only through TestFlight, and the public link is not yet open.
- 🔐 **Self-hosted, local-first, open source**: The Hub and SQLite data run on your own machine (the desktop app also bundles a local Hub). There is no SaaS hosting. Licensed under Apache 2.0.

## Get started in 30 seconds

**Option 1: Desktop app (recommended)**: Download the macOS, Windows, or Android app from [anet.sh](https://anet.sh). Route 1 is the domestic ModelScope mirror in China, and route 2 is GitHub. Choose "Local workspace" to use the built-in Hub. On the "Servers" page, install and start the local daemon with one click, then create nodes directly.

**Option 2: `anet` CLI** (requires Node.js ≥ 22.13)

```bash
curl -fsSL https://anet.sh/install.sh | sh    # Install the anet CLI
npm i -g bun                                   # Hub runs on Bun…
```

yanfei0725/dsh-qwen-paint.body:
# dsh-qwen-paint · (Drawing) Qwen (Optimized Edition)

A local image generation and editing plugin for **DeepSeek Harness**. It calls **Qwen-Image 2.1 / official Turbo** models through a local **ComfyUI** instance, enabling text-to-image, 1–3 image editing, local inpainting, element removal, and four-direction outpainting within the conversation. Results are saved to disk and displayed directly in the session interface.

## Features

| Capability | Tool | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Text-to-image | `draw_image` | Generates images from prompts; finished output is saved to disk and shown directly in the session |
| Image-to-image / multi-reference image editing | `draw_image` | 1–16 reference images (since 0.19.0), wired in by index to `images.image_N` |
| Local inpainting | `inpaint_image` | Redraws within the mask, then crops and pastes back |
| Element removal | `remove_image` | Removes objects within the mask and fills in the background |
| Four-direction outpainting | `outpaint_image` | Expands up / down / left / right by percentage |
| High-resolution upscaling | `upscale_image` | Shares the same node graph as the built-in upscaler |

- **Local, no API**: Image data (prompts and images) is sent only to the ComfyUI instance at `127.0.0.1` / `localhost` / `::1` on this machine, enforced in code by `lib/net-guard.js`. **No API keys required, no call fees.**
- **Models and runtime**: Calls **Qwen-Image 2.1 / official Turbo** through a local **ComfyUI** instance. No cloud model service is needed.
- **Platforms**: Windows / Linux, automatically adapts to NVIDIA / Intel Arc / AMD GPUs.
- **DSH compatibility**: `>=0.2.0-rc.2` (see `dsh.compatibility` in `package.json`).

## Installation

> **Don't want to use the command line**: double-click `一键安装.cmd` in the repository root. It first reports its version and `setup.mjs` fingerprint, then asks once after checking, before installing.

**Command-line install** (local directory form of `dsh plugin add`):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:<absolute path to this plugin directory>
```

> When using the `desktop` profile, you must **fully quit DSH first**. This package is **not published to npm**, so `dsh plugin add dsh-qwen-paint` by package name will not work. You must point to a local directory or local package. For full steps, profile selection, and troubleshooting, see the Installation section below and `INSTALL.md`.
